key_insight: Fine-tuning LLMs on explicit quantum circuit reasoning traces can teach genuine quantum reasoning, with SFT giving the strongest in-distribution accuracy and SFT+GRPO improving scalability to larger qubit systems.
engineering_relevance: This work suggests a practical pathway for building quantum-aware AI assistants that can support circuit analysis, simulation-based verification, and quantum software workflows.
method: Supervised fine-tuning on gate-by-gate state-vector simulation traces
Two-stage SFT + GRPO using verifiable rewards
Predict measurement probability distributions from quantum gate sequences
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that SFT achieved near-perfect in-distribution and gate-count extrapolation accuracy, outperforming both the base model and GPT-OSS-120B, while SFT+GRPO generalized better to larger qubit systems.
watch_item: Generalization gains from GRPO come with reduced in-distribution precision, so deployment will need careful balancing of accuracy, scalability, and simulator-based reward design.
paper_title: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Quantum Reasoning
